text:
Apply this explicit review correction limited to adaptation tasks and completeness assertions. Preserve every accepted requirement, input/output contract, all existing external operation IDs, their ordering, per-product navigation, writer path and cleanup. Do not introduce filtering/deduplication, new business criteria, new operations or increased limits.
The emitted BrowserObservationRecord fields are kind, tag, selector, group, text, href, role, reference and actions. It has NO resultIndex. Remove resultIndex from the extraction result contracts and decision inputs; original array order already supplies the requested order. Use the observed reference unchanged as candidateKey. A required source-grounded integer cannot be synthesized by learned mapping.
The learned extract_search_page_views should emit only pageId and candidates [{candidateKey,observedText}] from every complete page, with candidateKey copied from record.reference and observedText from record.text. Remove its originalRecords/requestedAction outputs: authoritative action data must not be recreated by learned mapping. Keep the offered-candidate lookup.
Add only the necessary pure foreach over original open_amazon_search.observationSnapshot.pages that exports field(item,"records"). Change the existing flatten_original_records to flatten those declared arrays. Its records must be the actual original Browser records, with no learned renaming. Resolve selected productKeys with lookup(port:"reference", items:[these original records,selected IDs]), after lookup_offered_candidates succeeded. Keep href non-null assertions before navigation. No index manufactured from text, hashes or positions in learned extraction.
Keep interpretation inputs compact, no original source snapshot forwarded with views. Keep the bounded product extraction and row/TSV contracts. Both search/product completeness checks must use the actual Browser success and snapshot completeness metadata. An incomplete observation is a failed acquisition, not a completed product row: do not turn an incomplete snapshot into a successful workbook via the fallback interpretation. Use the existing mandatory requires assertion before extracting from a product snapshot and preserve the existing cleanup on failure. Missing business fields from a complete snapshot still remain explicitly nullable.
Do not alter unrelated operations or replace writer-result outputs with constants. Existing typed projection/flatten/lookup and explicit runtime requires are sufficient.
